product_rule: ISS is a thin external runtime/effect adapter around the single SkatAI V2 decision system; ISS contains no independent AI policy.

all_phase_adapter.official_split_pickup_flow: declaration and discard are separate ISS half-moves, so each material network effect binds to one DecisionResult

external_effect_authority.journal: append-only fsynced JSONL with tamper-evident hash chain
rules: Persist INTENT before any external send.
Unresolved persisted effects are never blindly replayed after restart.
Retry requires explicit proof that the same protocol state/request remains pending.
First post-intent server move confirms the effect only when semantically equivalent.
A different first post-intent move aborts the intent as stale.
Connection/lifecycle flags do not alter protocol-state identity.
ISS-normalized ouvert discard echoes may append ten open-hand cards and still confirm the same two-card discard.

scientific_authority.external_gate: B1 vs B0 frozen external ISS gate
